signals.title: TheatAir 2026 (International Street Arts & Puppet Festival)
signals.when_text: September 4–7, 2026 (Various daytime and evening outdoor slots)
signals.location: Main Pedestrian Street, Roman Stadium Square, and Park Ribnitsa, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air street festival with giant puppet parades, circus acrobatics, and family-friendly outdoor performances right in the city center.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and bta.bg for September 4–7, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Unification Day Historical Reenactment & Festivities
signals.location: Roman Stadium Square and Unification Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Exciting costumed 1885 historical reenactment with authentic uniforms and horses that captures the attention of young children.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and podtepeto.com for September 6, 2026.

signals.title: Singing Fountains Musical & Water Screen Show (Season 2)
signals.reason: Spectacular colorful light, water fountain, and multimedia projection show in the central park, perfect for a relaxed family evening stroll.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and marica.bg for Saturday evenings in September 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Puppet Theatre: 'Koseto Bose' (Косе Босе)
signals.reason: Classic morning puppet show tailored perfectly for 4-year-olds based on the beloved Bulgarian tale.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for September 12, 2026 at 11:45 AM.

signals.title: Night of the Angels (Нощ на Ангелите) Charity Family Festival
signals.reason: Vibrant open-air community weekend at the canal featuring kids workshops, food trucks, crafts, and wide green lawns.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and angelsnight.bg for September 11–13, 2026.

signals.title: Kids Expo & Beerland Festival 2026
signals.location: Lauta Park / Bratska Mogila area, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Outdoor festival combining children's entertainment, games, and exhibits with craft food and drinks in a shaded park setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and eventibg.com for September 11–13, 2026.

signals.title: PlayCity Kids Festival & Expo 2026
signals.reason: Massive 7,500 sq. m interactive play haven featuring giant bouncy castles, interactive traffic safety tracks, climbing zones, and science workshops.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and bilet.bg for September 26–27, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: Expansive open-air grounds with real vintage fighter jets, passenger planes, and helicopters where young kids can explore freely.

signals.title: Bubbu Bear Children's Park & Center
signals.reason: Enclosed, safe outdoor park zone equipped with inflatables and play equipment tailored specifically for toddlers and young preschoolers.

signals.title: International Street Arts Festival TheatAir 2026
signals.location: Central streets, Kamenitsa stairs, Tsar Simeon Garden, and Ribnitsa Park, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air street performance festival featuring acrobatics, circus, fire shows, and giant puppets across central public spaces; completely visual and non-verbal.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and bta.bg for September 4–7, 2026.

signals.title: Slow. Art. Consumption. – Festival of Analog Art
signals.reason: Contemporary visual arts showcase dedicated to analog art forms and deliberate creation; visual exhibition format carries no language barrier.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and vplovdiv.com for September 4–26, 2026.

signals.title: Stand-Up Comedy in English with Elena Gabrielle
signals.location: Comedy Club Plovdiv, Gladstone St 15 (Boris Hristov House of Culture), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Touring English-language stand-up comedian performing locally in central Plovdiv; directly matches the scarce English comedy exemplar.
signals.note: Confirmed on comedyclub.bg and elenagabrielle.com for September 23, 2026.

signals.title: GuitArt Festival 2026: Yamandu Costa Solo Concert
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Latin Grammy-winning Brazilian 7-string acoustic guitar virtuoso playing a solo headlining concert; purely instrumental.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and guitart.bg for October 4, 2026.

signals.title: Festival of the Hills (Фестивал на тепетата)
signals.location: Across four Plovdiv hills (Old Town / Three Hills, Sahat Tepe, Bunardzhika, Youth Hill)
signals.reason: New multi-stage open-air cultural and outdoor festival spanning Plovdiv's iconic hills with historical craft, music, and nature installations.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and marica.bg for September 26–27, 2026.

signals.title: Major Street Closures, Checkpoints, and Drone Ban for Unification Day
signals.location: Saedinenie Square and 6th September Blvd (between Tsar Boris III and Ruski Blvd), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Complete vehicular closure on 6th September Boulevard from 15:00, security checkpoints from 18:00, and a strict 1km drone ban around Saedinenie Square for the national holiday.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and marica.bg for September 6, 2026.

signals.title: Complete Road Closure on Dr. G. M. Dimitrov Street
signals.location: Dr. G. M. Dimitrov Street (between Tsar Asen I St and Avksentiy Veleshki St), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Full vehicular closure on a key central downtown street near the university due to major infrastructure reconstruction.
signals.note: Confirmed on 24chasa.bg for ongoing road closure through September 13, 2026.

signals.title: 6th September Boulevard Section Closure and Bus Route Detours
signals.location: 6th September Blvd (between Vladivostok St and Turgenev St), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major boulevard segment closed for district heating pipe replacement, causing traffic detours and rerouting municipal bus lines 10, 15, and 17.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and podtepeto.com for closure through September 14, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Football Derby: Botev Plovdiv vs. Lokomotiv Plovdiv
signals.location: Hristo Botev Stadium (Kolezha) and surrounding central streets, Plovdiv
signals.reason: High-risk city derby match bringing massive crowds, road closures, and heavy police cordons around the stadium and Eastern Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on sportal.bg and botevplovdiv.bg for September 13, 2026.

signals.title: Opening of Bulgaria's First State-Backed 'Magazin za Horata' Grocery Store
signals.reason: Permanent civic opening of the country's first state-backed discount grocery store selling regulated staple goods.
signals.note: Confirmed closed on money.bg; the Ministry of Agriculture shut down the 'Magazin za Horata' project in April 2026.
